claim: The Saint-Tropez Sentier du Littoral loop is about 12 km (7.48 mi), moderate, ~3h45 walking, with roughly 110 m elevation gain, passing Pointe de la Rabiou, Pointe de Capon and Cap Pinet.
quote: Distance & Duration: 7.48 mi covering approximately 3 hours 45 minutes... gains 361 feet... Pointe de la Rabiou, Pointe de l'Ay, Cap de St-Tropez, Pointe de Capon (former battery), and Cap Pinet... Salins beach

claim: The Sentier du Littoral officially starts at La Ponche, Saint-Tropez's old fishing quarter; a short easy 10-minute walk reaches Plage des Graniers beside the Citadel, and the path is marked with yellow paint and 'Sentier du Littoral' signs.
quote: The 'official' start of the Sentier du Littoral is in La Ponche... Plage des Graniers is a pretty, sandy bay next to the imposing Citadel of St Tropez, easily reached via a 10-minute walk along the Sentier du Littoral coastal path

claim: The Saint-Tropez coastal path runs east from the Tour du Portalet past Baie des Canebiers, Pointe de la Rabiou, Cap des Salins, Pointe de Capon and Cap du Pinet to the white-sand beaches near Tahiti Plage.
quote: begins at the pier in St Tropez under the Tour du Portalet... Baie des Canebiers, Pointe de la Rabiou, Pointe de l'Ay, La Croisette, Cap des Salins, Pointe de Capon, Cap du Pinet... white sandy beaches just past Cap du Pinet

claim: Sea kayaking and paddleboard are available at Tiki Pep's (Escalet/Pampelonne, April-November); La Moune Watersports rents single kayaks at €15/hr, doubles €20/hr and paddleboards €20/hr.
quote: Tiki Pep's... sea kayaking and Stand up paddleboard excursions... Open April to November... La Moune Watersports... Single kayak €15/hour, Double kayak €20/hour, Paddle €20/hour

claim: Scuba diving is offered by Mio Palmo Plongée in Saint-Tropez (May-October, boat for 18 divers) and Cap Camarat Plongée at Pampelonne with over 30 dive sites specializing in wreck exploration.
quote: Mio Palmo Plongée, Saint Tropez... Operates May through October... Boat accommodates up to 18 divers... Cap Camarat Plongée, Ramatuelle... Over 30 dive sites... Specializes in wreck exploration

claim: Saint-Tropez boat and yacht rentals start from around $90/hr, with 30+ boats including powerboats, yachts, pontoons and jet skis, most departing the Vieux Port.
quote: 30+ boat & yacht rentals available starting from $90/hr, with options for powerboats, yachts, pontoons, and jet skis

claim: Les Voiles de Saint-Tropez 2026 runs 26 September-4 October, drawing about 250 boats - classic vessels over a century old, maxi yachts and contemporary racers - organized by the Société Nautique de Saint-Tropez (founded 1862; event first held 1999).
quote: Dates: September 26 - October 4, 2026... about 250 boats comprising three categories: classic vessels (some over a century old), maxi yachts, and contemporary boats... Société Nautique de Saint-Tropez... first organized this event in 1999

claim: Pep's Spirit (Ramatuelle) runs guided electric mountain-bike tours over 300 km of peninsula trails, €60 for 2 hours or €90 for the 3-hour E-Bike & Wine outing with tasting, daily 1 April-30 October, min 4 people.
quote: 300 kms of trails, all levels... €60 for 2-hour tours... €90 for 3-hour tours (includes the E-Bike & Wine experience with tasting)... From 01/04 to 30/10/2026 daily... Minimum group size is 4 people
